invariants: runner-owned global costs and model identities
threshold: Keep a component if its removal lowers overall or any question-kind score by more than the full engine three-run spread, or it is required for a safety/privacy result. Remove a component adding cost without a score gain.
policy: All arms use the same extraction prompt, then code filters the removed outputs. Proof facts remain in all arms. Episodes retain structural source grouping even when not recalled. Nightly removal retains weekly reflection. Importance removal stores zero proposed importance, removes importance from ranking, and fades all old episodes equally. Every arm and failed attempt is reported. The session-cutting control preserves the prior prompts and consolidation path; every other arm runs the same boundary-only prompt before nightly consolidation, including the no-nightly-consolidation removal. Weekly reflection does not repartition.

topic_segmentation.mode: Nightly bounded partitions of closed sessions, with exact ordered surviving-record coverage validated by code.
topic_segmentation.nightly_removal: Boundary-only calls remain; ordinary nightly consolidation is disabled.
topic_segmentation.oversized_sessions: Explicit continuation at 128 records, 64 KiB or the configured output ceiling; no topic may span that hard batch boundary.
